summary.zh: 并列句是由两个或两个以上语法地位相同、意义相互关联的独立分句组成的句子。每个独立分句都有自己的主语和谓语，能够单独成句，但通过并列连词、分号或连接副词组合后，可以表达递进、转折、选择、因果或对比关系。在 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 写作、口语中，熟练使用并列句可以提升句子多样性、逻辑清晰度和表达流畅度，尤其适合描述图表趋势、解释原因、比较观点和组织论证。

structure.formula: Independent Clause + Coordinating Conjunction + Independent Clause
structure.explanation: 并列句的核心结构是“独立分句 + 并列连接方式 + 独立分句”。常见的 coordinating conjunctions 包括 for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so，可用 FANBOYS 记忆。两个独立分句之间通常需要逗号加并列连词，例如“..., but ...”。也可以用分号连接两个关系密切的独立分句，或使用分号加连接副词，如 however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless。需要注意的是，并列句连接的是两个完整句子，而不是单个词组或从属分句。

examples.en: The survey was conducted online, and the results were analysed by independent researchers.
examples.zh: 该调查是在线进行的，并且结果由独立研究人员进行了分析。

examples.en: Many students prefer online courses, but face-to-face instruction remains important.
examples.zh: 许多学生更喜欢在线课程，但面对面教学仍然很重要。

examples.en: The policy reduced traffic congestion; however, it increased public dissatisfaction.
examples.zh: 该政策减少了交通拥堵；然而，它增加了公众的不满。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达并列或补充信息
usage_scenarios.description: 当两个独立分句的信息方向一致，且第二个分句对第一个分句进行补充、扩展或延续时，可以使用 and, moreover, furthermore 等连接方式。此类结构在 IELTS Task 2 和 PTE Write Essay 中常用于扩展论点。

examples.en: Public transport is affordable, and it helps reduce carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 公共交通价格实惠，并且有助于减少碳排放。

examples.en: The programme improves students' digital literacy; moreover, it prepares them for modern workplaces.
examples.zh: 该项目提高学生的数字素养；此外，它还能帮助他们适应现代职场。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达转折或让步关系
usage_scenarios.description: 当两个独立分句在意义上形成对比时，可以使用 but, yet, however, nevertheless 等。学术写作中，however 和 nevertheless 通常比 but 更正式，但标点要求更严格。

examples.en: The method is cost-effective, but it may not be suitable for all participants.
examples.zh: 这种方法具有成本效益，但它可能并不适合所有参与者。

examples.en: The data appear reliable; however, the sample size is relatively small.
examples.zh: 这些数据看起来可靠；然而，样本量相对较小。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达结果或因果关系
usage_scenarios.description: 当第二个独立分句表示第一个分句导致的结果时，可以使用 so, therefore, consequently, thus 等。PTE 写作中，这类结构有助于清楚呈现逻辑链。

examples.en: The company invested heavily in automation, so productivity increased significantly.
examples.zh: 该公司大量投资自动化，因此生产率显著提高。

examples.en: Urban populations are growing rapidly; therefore, governments must expand public services.
examples.zh: 城市人口正在快速增长；因此，政府必须扩大公共服务。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达选择关系
usage_scenarios.description: 当两个独立分句表示不同选择或可能性时，可以使用 or。该结构适用于讨论解决方案、政策选择或个人决策。

examples.en: Governments can increase funding for public schools, or they can encourage private investment in education.
examples.zh: 政府可以增加对公立学校的资金投入，或者鼓励私人投资教育。

examples.en: Students should revise their essays carefully, or they may lose marks for grammatical errors.
examples.zh: 学生应仔细修改作文，否则可能因语法错误而失分。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述图表中的对比趋势
usage_scenarios.description: 在 IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 和 PTE Describe Image 中，并列句可以用来同时呈现两个数据趋势，尤其适合对比上升与下降、增长与稳定。

examples.en: The number of international students rose steadily, whereas domestic enrolments remained stable.
examples.zh: 国际学生人数稳步上升，而本地学生入学人数保持稳定。

examples.en: Sales increased in the first quarter, but they declined sharply in the second quarter.
examples.zh: 销售额在第一季度上升，但在第二季度急剧下降。

common_mistakes.wrong: Many people support online learning, it is convenient and flexible.
common_mistakes.correct: Many people support online learning because it is convenient and flexible. / Many people support online learning, for it is convenient and flexible.
common_mistakes.explanation: 这是中国学习者常见的 comma splice（逗号拼接）错误。两个完整句子不能只用逗号连接。应使用从属连词 because，或使用并列连词 for，也可以改为分号。

common_mistakes.wrong: The city is crowded but the public transport system is efficient.
common_mistakes.correct: The city is crowded, but the public transport system is efficient.
common_mistakes.explanation: 当 but 连接两个独立分句时，but 前通常需要加逗号。若 but 只连接两个短语，则不一定需要逗号。

common_mistakes.wrong: The research is limited, however it provides useful insights.
common_mistakes.correct: The research is limited; however, it provides useful insights.
common_mistakes.explanation: however 是连接副词，不是 coordinating conjunction。它不能像 but 一样直接用逗号连接两个独立分句。正式写作中常用“分号 + however + 逗号”。

common_mistakes.wrong: The government should reduce taxes, and increase public spending.
common_mistakes.correct: The government should reduce taxes and increase public spending.
common_mistakes.explanation: 这里 and 连接的是两个动词短语 reduce taxes 和 increase public spending，而不是两个独立分句，因此通常不需要逗号。很多中国学生会过度使用逗号，影响句子自然度。

common_mistakes.wrong: Some people prefer living in cities, but others living in rural areas.
common_mistakes.correct: Some people prefer living in cities, but others prefer living in rural areas.
common_mistakes.explanation: but 后面的分句缺少谓语动词 prefer，导致结构不完整。并列句要求连接的两个部分在语法上平衡，尤其在对比句中要保持 parallel structure。

common_mistakes.wrong: Technology improves efficiency, so that many companies adopt digital tools.
common_mistakes.correct: Technology improves efficiency, so many companies adopt digital tools.
common_mistakes.explanation: so 和 so that 含义不同。so 连接结果，表示“所以”；so that 引导目的状语从句，表示“以便”。此句表达结果，应使用 so。

common_mistakes.wrong: The lecture was difficult, and many students still understood the main argument.
common_mistakes.correct: The lecture was difficult, yet many students still understood the main argument.
common_mistakes.explanation: and 表示顺承或补充，但这里前后存在转折关系。使用 yet 或 but 更符合逻辑。PTE 写作评分重视 meaning 和 coherence，连接词选择不当会削弱逻辑。

pte_usage.description: 并列句在 PTE Academic 中非常实用，尤其适用于 Write Essay、Summarize Written Text、Summarize Spoken Text、Describe Image 和 Retell Lecture。它可以帮助考生在有限时间内构建清晰、准确且具有一定复杂度的句子。与过长的复杂句相比，并列句更容易控制语法准确性；与简单句相比，并列句又能体现更好的句法多样性。考生应避免大量使用 and 机械连接信息，而要根据逻辑关系选择 but, so, yet, therefore, however 等连接方式。
sections: PTE Write Essay：用于连接两个论点、原因或结果，使段落逻辑更连贯。
PTE Summarize Written Text：可用一个并列句整合文章中的两个核心信息，但必须避免逗号拼接。
PTE Summarize Spoken Text：适合概括讲座中的对比观点、因果关系和补充信息。
PTE Describe Image：可用于同时描述两个趋势，例如一个数据上升而另一个数据下降。
PTE Retell Lecture：帮助考生用清晰结构复述多个相关信息点，提高 fluency 和 grammatical range。

academic_patterns.pattern: X is widely accepted, but Y remains controversial.
academic_patterns.translation: X 被广泛接受，但 Y 仍然存在争议。

academic_patterns.pattern: X has increased significantly, whereas Y has remained relatively stable.
academic_patterns.translation: X 显著增加，而 Y 保持相对稳定。

academic_patterns.pattern: X contributes to economic growth, and it also improves social welfare.
academic_patterns.translation: X 有助于经济增长，并且也改善社会福利。

academic_patterns.pattern: X may reduce costs; however, it can create long-term risks.
academic_patterns.translation: X 可能降低成本；然而，它可能造成长期风险。

academic_patterns.pattern: X is becoming more common; therefore, policymakers need to respond effectively.
academic_patterns.translation: X 正变得越来越普遍；因此，政策制定者需要有效应对。

academic_patterns.pattern: The evidence is limited, yet it suggests a clear trend.
academic_patterns.translation: 证据有限，但它显示出一个明确趋势。

academic_patterns.pattern: Some people support X, while others argue that Y is more important.
academic_patterns.translation: 一些人支持 X，而另一些人认为 Y 更重要。

academic_patterns.pattern: The problem is complex, so a single solution is unlikely to be sufficient.
academic_patterns.translation: 这个问题很复杂，因此单一解决方案不太可能足够。

collocations.translation: 展示两个观点之间的对比

ai_tips: 写作检查时，先判断连接词左右两边是否都是完整句子；如果都是完整句子，就要特别注意逗号、分号和连接词的搭配。
在 PTE Summarize Written Text 中，不要为了压缩信息而用逗号硬接多个句子；可以使用 and, but, so 或分号来形成语法正确的并列句。
如果想表达正式转折，优先考虑“; however,”或“; nevertheless,”，而不是连续使用 but。
图表描述中可以用 but 或 whereas 对比两个趋势，但要保证两个分句的时态一致。
不要把所有信息都用 and 串联。根据逻辑选择连接词，才能体现更高的 grammatical range 和 coherence。

practice_questions.question: 将两个简单句合并为一个并列句：The population increased rapidly. Public services became insufficient.
practice_questions.answer: The population increased rapidly, so public services became insufficient. 解析：第二句是第一句导致的结果，因此使用 so。

practice_questions.question: 改正错误：The policy is effective, however it is expensive to implement.
practice_questions.answer: The policy is effective; however, it is expensive to implement. 解析：however 是连接副词，连接两个独立分句时通常使用“分号 + however + 逗号”。

practice_questions.question: 选择最合适的连接词：The results were promising, ___ the experiment needs to be repeated. A. and B. but C. so
practice_questions.answer: B. but。句意为“结果很有希望，但实验需要重复进行”，前后是转折关系。

practice_questions.question: 判断句子是否正确：Many students study abroad, and gain international experience.
practice_questions.answer: 这个句子语法可以接受，但逗号通常不需要。更自然的表达是：Many students study abroad and gain international experience. 因为 and 连接的是两个动词短语，而不是两个独立分句。

practice_questions.question: 用 therefore 合并句子：The demand for housing has risen. Property prices have increased.
practice_questions.answer: The demand for housing has risen; therefore, property prices have increased. 解析：therefore 表示结果，正式写作中常用分号连接前后两个独立分句。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写得更学术：People use cars a lot, so the air gets worse.
practice_questions.answer: Private car use has increased significantly, so air quality has deteriorated. 解析：使用 private car use, increased significantly, air quality, deteriorated 等更学术的表达。

practice_questions.question: 找出错误并改正：Some argue that technology improves education, but others believe traditional methods.
practice_questions.answer: Some argue that technology improves education, but others believe that traditional methods are more effective. 解析：but 后面的独立分句不完整，需要补足谓语或宾语从句内容。

practice_questions.question: 根据中文写英文并列句：这项研究样本量较小，但其结论仍然具有参考价值。
practice_questions.answer: The study has a small sample size, but its findings are still valuable. 或 The study has a small sample size; nevertheless, its findings are still valuable.
